title: Strict inclusion of degradable channels in the less-noisy class
source:
Watanabe proved the inclusion of degradable channels in the regularized
less-noisy class and explicitly left open whether it is strict
\sourcecite{ref:p47-watanabe}{Wat12}.
progress:
Watanabe proved that every degradable channel satisfies
  Eq.~\eqref{eq:p47-watanabe-less-noisy}, but left open whether this inclusion
  is strict \sourcecite{ref:p47-watanabe}{Wat12}.

Belzig, Gao, Smith, and Wu constructed nondegradable channels satisfying
  the one-copy version of Eq.~\eqref{eq:p47-regularized-order}.  Their result
  separates degradability from the level-1 less-noisy condition, while
  explicitly leaving the all-blocklength condition in
  Eq.~\eqref{eq:p47-regularized-order} unresolved
  \sourcecite{ref:p47-belzig}{BGSW25}.

comment:
The answer is affirmative: the complement of the channel in
Eq.~\eqref{eq:p47-zhu-wang-channel} proves that degradable channels form a
proper subset of Watanabe-less-noisy channels.  The resolving result
\sourcecite{ref:p47-zhu-wang}{ZW26} is, as of August 2026, a recent preprint;
the solved status records its theorem rather than peer-review history.
